generation_notes.purpose: Believable fictional male boxer names for a 1975 American boxing gym management game.
generation_notes.usage: Select a city, use its city_weights to choose a first-name subpool and surname subpool, then randomly select one name from each chosen pool.
generation_notes.nickname_usage: Choose nickname categories based on fighter style, traits, reputation, or generated press identity. Nicknames are not region-locked.
generation_notes.realism_target: Authentic aggregate feel rather than strict census modeling.
